svg.title: Blueprint sheet 21, the watering can: most need, least care (after Julian Tudor Hart, the inverse care law, 1971)

g.text: good care tends to go where it’s least needed
for the water to fall here.
the old saying: them as has, gets.
inversely with the need for it
long word: the inverse care law
after Julian Tudor Hart, a doctor
turning it round is the stated aim
a living blueprint for a world
